meta.title: Synapse Academy — Master AI Engineering by Building It
meta.description: A rigorous, hands-on AI engineering curriculum: from the mathematics of neural networks to autonomous agents in production.

home.title: Master AI Engineering by Building It
home.subtitle: From the mathematics of neural networks to autonomous agents in production. Read the problem, derive the math, write the code, ship the artifact — end to end, by hand.
home.featuresTitle: An education that respects your intelligence
home.featuresSubtitle: Not another video course. A build-first path from first principles to production systems.
home.feature1Body: Derive the mathematics, then implement it by hand in Python, TypeScript, Rust and Julia — before reaching for a framework.
home.feature2Body: You don't just read. Each lesson produces a reusable prompt, skill, agent or MCP server you keep forever.
home.feature3Body: Built-in quizzes check real understanding per lesson and per phase — not passive completion.
home.feature4Body: Study in an English-first curriculum with a fully Japanese interface. Switch languages anytime.
home.pathTitle: A linear path, twenty phases deep
home.pathSubtitle: Start where you are. Every phase builds on the last.
home.ctaSectionTitle: Ready to build AI from scratch?
home.ctaSectionBody: Begin with the foundations, or jump to the phase that fits your level.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.subtitle: Twenty phases, from setup to autonomous systems. {count} lessons in total.
curriculum.yourLevelBody: Complete beginners start at Phase 0. Python developers new to ML start at Phase 1. Engineers targeting LLMs and agents can jump to Phase 10.

lesson.sourceBody: Adapted from the open-source “AI Engineering from Scratch” curriculum by Rohit Goel, used under the MIT license.
